lines.text: Believers scattered by the persecution that began with Stephen traveled to Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, and men from Cyprus and Cyrene spoke to Greeks too.
A great number believed, and the church in Jerusalem sent Barnabas to Antioch.
Barnabas rejoiced at the grace of God in Antioch, then went to Damascus to look for Saul.
Barnabas brought Saul to Antioch, where disciples were first called Christians, and the prophet Agabus predicted a great plague.
The disciples decided to send relief to the brothers in Judea, sending their gifts to the elders with Barnabas and Saul.
